done_when: A new prototype's sign-in question lists email and password first, then one-time codes, then company sign-in, and states that the client chooses the method.
why: The sign-in question in the guide offers only two methods, so a client who wants one-time codes sees no choice for it, and the owner wants that option added, with email and password kept as the default and a clear note that the method is the client's choice.
